svg.title: organization program
svg.desc: Three square cells in an L and a fourth lifted out and turned, cut from a blue-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md), solid fills and no strokes, with one exception to the 2.5-unit gap: by the owner's choice, the lifted cell sits 1.5 units from the others, about 0.8 CSS pixels at 16. Centred by eye, halfway from its box centre to its centre of mass, which leaves the lifted cell room to be 7.5 units across. Chosen 2026-11-07, the owner's first favorite: redrawn after the apps icon of Fluent UI System Icons (Microsoft, MIT), with square corners; the ideas it was chosen from are in docs/prototypes/program-mark-ideas.html.
